messages:
elaine_pm: Quick sync 9 — Partner asks for a phased rollout: tenant opt-in, deterministic canary, A/B quality checks, and a visible fallback path. Need to map responsibilities and minimal launch criteria.

sam_eng: Implementation sketch: per-tenant feature-flag + deterministic hash for canary buckets (tenant_id % 100). A/B routing can be done at the gateway layer; keep assignment sticky for 24h.

nora_eng: Agree. Add a "canary pool" to isolate cache and KV so we don't contaminate production pools. We'll also expose a small UI to toggle "Opt-in for partner canary" for tenant-admins (read-only unless consent recorded). ETA: 2 sprints for API + UI.

dmitri_sre: Telemetry gates: pre-cutover baseline for 30m; post-cutover watch 60m. Automated actions: SOFT_DEGRADE -> route to lighter model variant if p95 > baseline*1.5 for 3m; HARD_FALLBACK -> route to legacy path if errors > 2% or p95 > baseline*2 for 2m. Manual rollback if quality delta > threshold or customer complains.

jia_prodops: Scheduling notes: prodops owns the maintenance window; require 48h notice for dedicated/private. We will schedule warm-up + smoke tests 30m before cutover and attach a runbook link to calendar invite.

cs_ops: For partner communication, we'll use a standard consent template and capture consent doc URL in the tenant record. Partners want EU-local logs/audit — mark that as a must-have if tenant.region == "EU".

elaine_pm: Launch criteria proposal: 1) consent recorded for tenant-admins, 2) canary shadowed for 24h with no quality regressions > 0.5pt average, 3) latency and error-rate gates pass for two consecutive windows (30m each), 4) runbook and oncall assigned. Approve to proceed?

sam_eng: +1. I'll draft the spec and add API examples.

nora_eng: +1. I'll include UI mock and canary pool config.

dmitri_sre: +1. I'll publish the thresholds and a concise runbook for auto-actions.

jia_prodops: +1. I'll prepare the calendar automation and ops checklist.

cs_ops: +1. I'll adapt the consent template and include CS playbook.

elaine_pm: OK agreed. Next steps: sam open spec PR, nora add UI PR, dmitri post runbook, jia create scheduling tasks. Weekly sync Friday 11am. :rocket:
